item.title: Version 1.0.24
item.description:
fix: pre-flight backend health check before iPhone supervise

Before starting the destructive supervise + reboot flow on your
iPhone, Flipped now pings the backend with a 5-second timeout. If
the server is mid-redeploy or unreachable, you get a clear retry
prompt instead of a stuck iPhone in DEP enrollment.

Also includes the structured onboarding error recovery from 1.0.23:
SetupErrorRecovery now pattern-matches known failures (cable, lock,
Find My, Stolen Device Protection, passcode, backup/restore,
tools-missing) into a numbered recovery card instead of raw stderr.

Adds ~1 second to the happy path. Saves a brick when the backend
is having a moment.
